name: spotify-web-watcher
description: A Chrome Extension that watches the Spotify Web Player and reports what you are playing on a private web page.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && esbuild src/content.js src/popup.js src/background.js src/welcome.js --bundle --minify --target=chrome110 --outdir=dist && node tools/replace-bad-character.js dist/content.js dist/popup.js dist/background.js dist/welcome.js && cp manifest.json src/popup.html src/welcome.html dist/ && cp -R icons dist/
